text:
maria_cs: Quick sync 1: Peregrine Dedicated pool turns live Tue 09:00 PT. Need alignment on quota windows, autoscale plumbing, and load-test timing. I started a runbook (WIP): https://redwood-docs.internal/peregrine/dedicated-runbook
liam_se: Can we get 30m tomorrow 11:30 PT? Want to validate their traffic profile0% short-chat, 30% long chat, 50% async batch embeddings.
natalie_sre: Works for me. For monitoring, add metrics: per-pool tokens/s, queue depth, GPU mem headroom, OOM/retry counters. Propose alerts: gpu_util > 85% for 5m, queue_depth > 200 for 2m.
jordan_eng: Model fallback chain: rwd-13b-quant -> rwd-13b-onnx -> rwd-7b-quant. Fallback when 95th pct latency > 1.5s. We'll need manual rollback runbook if quality degrades.
liam_se: Load test plan: two phases. Phase A: steady-state equivalent 5k rps for 30m. Phase B: burst spikes (10m) to simulate peak. k6 script uploaded. Example run:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m scripts/peregrine_chat_profile.js
```
devon_onboard: I'll run customer enablement Fri 15:00 PT 0min walk-through of rate-limits, warmup, KV caching, and fallback behavior. Jordan can you join for prompt guidance?
jordan_eng: Yep Fri 15 I can join. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching to reduce token costs on warmed sessions (~25% savings). Customer consent recorded in onboarding form.
ops-bot: Reservation confirmed: reserved-dedicated-pool-peregrine (8 x A100) 2025-03-25 08:00 to 2025-04-01 08:00 UTC. Maintenance window 2025-03-26 01:00-03:00 UTC may affect routing.
maria_cs: Autoscale defaults we usually use: min=2, target=6, max=12, scale-up-cooldown=60s, scale-down-cooldown=300s. Thoughts?
liam_se: For Peregrine's bursty profile, increase scale-down to 600s to avoid oscillation. Also add soft-cap throttle at 90% GPU util to signal clients before hard rejects.
natalie_sre: Agreed. I'll add the soft-cap (90%), create dashboards and a pager rotation for the test windows. Escalation steps will be in the runbook.
devon_onboard: Customer asked for a shadowing test (mirror 10% prod) to validate routing and caching. Is shadowing allowed and billable?
maria_cs: They opted into shadowing in contract. Billing: shadow tokens flagged as no-charge. We must toggle a console flag and note it in billing notes.
liam_se: Proposed load-test schedule: Wed 02:00 PT steady-state, Thu 02:00 PT blast-to-failure. Ops needs 48h to clear other tenants 048h notice requested.
jordan_eng: Also want to pre-warm KV cache using a scripted warmup that mirrors typical prefix lengths. That reduces cold-start latency.
maria_cs: Action items: 1) Liam finalize k6 scripts + perf targets (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Natalie add alerts/dashboards and throttle rule (before load test). 3) Devon finalize enablement deck and confirm Fri session (due Thu midday). 4) Jordan enable KV cache + document fallback QoS (before runbook freeze).
liam_se: I'll drop updated k6 link here when ready.
natalie_sre: Creating pager rota and writing escalation docs now.
maria_cs: FYI renewal watch: Peregrine renewal in ~6 months, flagged high-touch. Capture any SLA/billing concerns during enablement.
devon_onboard: Will capture feedback and file product asks post-session.
maria_cs: Meeting tomorrow 11:30 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
